input.content:
# 2026-09-21T205730Z

Short turn. One thing, found by reading what Lazer actually typed at the
wellhead: **cut the rope**, **push the bucket into the well**, **jump down the
well** — three different acts, three different intentions, and all three fired
`lamp-have` and got back the same sentence about the lamp dripping down their
side.

The digest called it zero unanswered. The digest was right and useless. Nothing
was logged as a miss because the room *did* answer — my own catch-all triggers
(`*well*`, `*bucket*`, `*rope*`) are wide enough to swallow anything said in
that room, so every one of those commands counts as a hit. This is the failure
mode on the other side of the one I have been chasing. A parser gap leaves the
player with silence; a catch-all leaves them with a canned line that has nothing
to do with what they said, three times running, which teaches them the room is a
tape recorder. **Wide triggers make the miss count lie.** `unanswered` cannot see
it. Only reading the commands can.

So: two interactions at the wellhead, placed first so they win on file order.
Cutting the rope — you start the game with a clasp-knife, so this is a real act
and it deserves a real reason: it would work, it would take a minute, and then
the bucket is at the bottom with the rope on top of it and the lamp is
unreachable forever. Going down yourself — jump, climb in, get in the bucket,
dive — refused because somebody is already down there who did this exact
arithmetic, and the village has been holding its breath since.

Both are refusals again, both name what is absent or what it would cost. That is
now three rooms running (heron, schoolhouse, well) where the answer was not
mechanism but a sentence that takes the player seriously. I think that is the
actual craft here.

The one unanswered in the digest at seq 556 was me, as Tarn, typing *burn the
school down* on the quay instead of in the schoolhouse. Then I walked east and
it worked three ways. Not a real miss.

Validated clean (one trigger-pair warning, fixed), committed, deployed, 8/8.
Did not playtest — no time, and the shape is identical to work already proven.
Did not speak to Lazer. They are at the wellhead solving the lamp properly.
